name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Partner & Business Development | Inbound Qualification, Discovery & Routing
summary: Business development and partner-facing seller who qualifies fast, asks the questions that matter, and routes every serious opportunity to the right next step. Started as a BDR booking sales-ready meetings, then ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo and managed a 15-20 reseller partner book at Birdeye with ~94% retention. Builds the lead scoring, qualification, and routing systems himself in Salesforce, HubSpot, and AI-enabled workflow tools, and keeps CRM data clean enough to trust. Fintech exposure through a banking-industry client and a finalist-stage pursuit of a major bank.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built lead scoring, qualification criteria, and lifecycle stages that decide which inbound leads get fast human follow-up and which go to nurture.
Architected 20+ CRM automation workflows covering lead capture, tagging, routing, qualification, and booking, cutting response time on new inquiries.
Run discovery with prospective clients to surface goals, business model, buying process, and readiness, then recommend a scoped next step.
Call LLM APIs and configure webhooks in Zapier, Make, and n8n to enrich and prioritize leads, including an audit workflow that enrolled 180+ businesses.
Grew a free audit offer through organic LinkedIn engagement, converting inbound interest into qualified sales conversations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed ~3 multi-stakeholder client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Translated performance data into clear recommendations and quarterly business reviews for client leadership.

bullets: Sold to and onboarded 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94%).
Worked 50+ partner activities a day across channel sales and onboarding, keeping every partner moving to a defined next step.
Worked intent, enrichment, and routing data synced to Salesforce (including ZoomInfo) to prioritize partner outreach.
Routed structured partner feedback to Product and Engineering, linking field signals to roadmap decisions.

Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.
